benchmark_metadata.description: 30 benchmark questions re-asked in Hindi (Devanagari script) and Hinglish (Hindi in Latin letters). Each item points to its English original in eval_dataset.json (source_id) and is scored with that question's reference keywords, so English and translated accuracy are directly comparable.
benchmark_metadata.note: Translations were written for this benchmark; have a native speaker review them before citing results.
